    Branching morphisms #

    A nonzero morphism of a ray category branches if it has two different first arrows, while every proper left factor has only one first arrow. If two different paths have the same nonzero value, a branching morphism exists (exists_isBranch). In a convex piece of the cover, a lift of a branching morphism gives branch data for the polygon of its interval.
